## Aedvectis (CR 7)

This grotesque creature has black, multifaceted eyes and a thin, 6-inch-long nose, under which you can see a bloodied maw of needle-like teeth. Even still, it wears a powdered wig, a stylish outfit fit for a noble court and handles a blade with practiced grace.  

**XP** 3,200  
NE Medium monstrous humanoid  
**Init** +4; **Senses** darkvision 90 ft., scent; Perception +13; Aura mental haze (20 ft., DC 17)  


**Defense**


**AC** 21, touch 15, flat-footed 16 (+4 Dex, +1 dodge, +6 natural)  
**hp** 117 (9d10+27)  
**Fort** +6, **Ref** +10, **Will** +7  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** +1 rapier +15/+10 (1d6+5/15-20 plus bleed) and bite +8 (1d8+1 plus bleed, disease and grab) or bite +13 (1d8+5 plus bleed, disease and grab)  
**Special Attacks** bleed (2d4), blood drain (1d2 Constitution), draw blood  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 9th; concentration +12)  


At will—alter self, bleed (DC 13), blood biography (DC 15), disguise self (DC 14)  

3/day—charm person (DC 14), modify memory (DC 17)  



**Statistics**


**Str** 14, **Dex** 19, **Con** 17, **Int** 13, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 16  
**Base Atk** +9; **CMB** +13 (+17 grapple); **CMD** 26  
**Feats** Deceitful, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Improved Critical (rapier), [Weapon Finesse](../../rules/feats/weapon-finesse.md), Weapon Focus (rapier) Skills Bluff +22, Diplomacy +12, Disguise +22, Intimidate +8, Knowledge (nobility) +4, Perception +13, Sense Motive +4, Stealth +10;**Racial Modifiers** +8 Bluff, +8 Diplomacy, +8 Disguise  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility; Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
**Languages** Common  


**Special Abilities**


**Disease (Ex)** Mindmelt: Bite—injury; *save* Fortitude DC 17; onset 1 hour; *frequency* 1 day; *effect* 1d3 Wisdom Damage, see below; *cure* 2 consecutive saves.
